description.zh: 列表当前页号， 大于等于1。
description.en: The page number of the current page. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

description.zh:
实体类型。取值：
- ip：ip
- domain：域名
- url：url
- process：进程
- file：文件
- host：主机
- cloud_account：云账号
- container：容器
- bucket：对象存储
description.en:
The entity type. Valid values:
- ip: IP address
- domain: domain name
- url: URL
- process: process
- file: file
- host: host
- cloud_account: cloud account
- container: container
- bucket: Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

description.zh:
是否恶意实体。 取值：
- 0：否
- 1：是
description.en:
Specifies whether the entity is malicious. Valid values:
- 0: No.
- 1: Yes.

description.zh: 列表每页条数， 最大不超过100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region in which the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. Select the region based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:
- cn-hangzhou: the assets reside in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
- ap-southeast-1: the assets reside in regions outside China.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The view type. Valid values:

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
- 1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise.

description.zh:
实体标签。格式为JSON数组字符串：

`"[{"tagKey1":"tagValue1"},{"tagKey2":"tagValue2"}]"`
description.en:
The entity tags. The value is a JSON array string:

`"[{"tagKey1":"tagValue1"},{"tagKey2":"tagValue2"}]"`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem list-entities --incident-uuid 85ea4241-798f-4684-a876-65d4f0c30000 --entity-type ip --entity-name host10000 --entity-uuid 6c740667-80b2-476d-8924-2e706feb0000 --entity-uuids 6c740667-80b2-476d-8924-2e706feb0000,6c740667-80b2-476d-8924-2e706feb0000 --malware-type aliyun.siem.sas.alert_tag.miner_software --is-malware-entity 1 --tags tagKey1_:_tagValue1_,_tagKey2_:_tagValue2 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloud-siem ListEntities --region cn-hangzhou --EntityName host10000 --PageSize 10 --RoleType 1 --MalwareType 'aliyun.siem.sas.alert_tag.miner_software' --EntityType ip --EntityUuid '6c740667-80b2-476d-8924-2e706feb0000' --CurrentPage 1 --EntityUuids '6c740667-80b2-476d-8924-2e706feb0000,6c740667-80b2-476d-8924-2e706feb0000' --IsMalwareEntity 1 --RoleFor 1130916744880000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --IncidentUuid '85ea4241-798f-4684-a876-65d4f0c30000' --Tags 'tagKey1_:_tagValue1_,_tagKey2_:_tagValue2'
